usedFor: StoreHippo holds orders and customers, and Razorpay creates a payment request through “Create Payment Link” for each “New Order”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Each order gets a shareable link with its amount, expiry and customer details.

watchOut: “Create Payment Link” sets an amount and customer details, so map them from each “New Order”.
